_meta.description: Machine-readable domain map for agents. Copy to docs/domain/agent-index.json in the consumer project.

layer-context.rule: Each value MUST be a key from standards.manifest.json agentLoadPlans.

validValues.backend.domain: Aggregate, value objects, domain events, invariants
validValues.backend.infrastructure: EF Core, repositories, outbox, migrations, external clients
validValues.frontend.app: Next.js routes, features, hooks, Server Actions, Playwright E2E

layer-context.multiValue: List every agentLoadPlans key touched by the use case (for example write + API + UI).

conventions.rule: Each value MUST be a key from standards.manifest.json conventionIndex (for example backend.domainLayer).
